reviewed_invariants: The pilot always assigns the staged-picker candidate to engine A and the accepted base to engine B; fastchess reverses colors for each of 64 sequential opening pairs.
Both roles use the same Rodent V1.2 model, Threads=1, GOMAXPROCS=1, Hash=128, OwnBook=false, Move Overhead=100 and 10+0.1 clock under the accepted supervised candidate-match harness.
The base and candidate UCI binaries are distinct, hash-frozen, and built with Go 1.25.5, GOAMD64=v3, CGO_ENABLED=0 and -trimpath from the recorded source commits and trees.
Pilot openings 1-64 and confirmation source lines 201-400 are hash-frozen before scores; the confirmation corpus is disjoint from the pilot corpus.
The pilot can advance only under the predeclared upper-bound and independent-mechanism rule; confirmation accepts only at a strictly positive paired-bootstrap lower95 Elo bound.
Neither phase can extend, rerun, change openings, tune a constant, reverse semantic roles, or substitute a binary after scores.
Every phase retains independent legal/terminal, operational, process-tree, supervisor, CPU telemetry and artifact-hash evidence.
The procfs disappearance repair changes only non-owned-CPU observation and is covered by a regression test; engine execution, clocks, affinity, scoring and audits remain in the frozen helper.
The Lean hopper remains live and is neither paused nor managed by this gate.
limitations: The ten timing blocks were noisy even though their precommitted median passed at 0.95027; individual timing rows are not interpreted as Elo.
The worst fixed-depth node ratio, 1.14781, passed but is close to the 1.15 rejection cap.
The canonical opening sets were used by earlier independent feature gates, but they were fixed before this candidate produced any score and no picker constant was fitted to them.
This gate provides relative one-thread evidence only and cannot by itself prove an absolute 3300 rating.

authorization.scope: run the single frozen 64-pair pilot and, only if its unchanged rule requires it, the single frozen 200-pair confirmation
